281065803.description: This large quartz crystal geode specimen features a rough tan-brown outer rock matrix with a hollow interior lined with clear to white quartz crystals. The crystals are well-formed and densely clustered, creating a sparkling effect inside the cavity. The geode is in natural, unpolished condition with some minor earth staining on the exterior. It weighs approximately 3.9 lbs and measures about 5 to 6 inches in length.
